en.description:
Clear the line before it reaches the top.

A falling tetromino puzzle built for Apple Watch. No phone, no account, no internet. Pieces drop one at a time into a ten by twenty well. Turn them, slide them, and fit them together so a row fills completely and clears. Leave a gap and the stack creeps upward until there is no room left.

TURN THE CROWN TO AIM
- The Digital Crown moves the piece one column per detent, with no drift or inertia
- Tap once to rotate clockwise, twice to rotate the other way
- Swipe to move the piece or to send it straight down
- Haptic feedback confirms every landing

WATCH THE NUMBERS CLIMB
- Level, lines cleared and score are on screen the whole time
- The next piece is previewed beside the well, so you can plan the drop
- Your best score is kept and shown next to the current one
- The drop speeds up as the level rises

PICK IT BACK UP
The game in progress is saved as you play, so a piece mid-fall, the stack under it and your score are all still there the next time you raise your wrist. There is a pause button whenever you need it.

BUILT FOR THE WATCH
The well is sized to the screen you actually have, so the playfield fills a 41mm watch and an Ultra equally well without shrinking the pieces to nothing.

Runs on Apple Watch on its own, with no iPhone nearby. No account, no ads, no tracking and no internet connection needed. Your game never leaves your watch.
en.subtitle: Turn the crown, clear the line
